mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id, customer_id, status, placed_at, ship_recipient_name, ship_postal_code, ship_prefecture, ship_city, ship_address_line, ship_country, bill_recipient_name, bill_postal_code, bill_prefecture, bill_city, bill_address_line, bill_country) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{status}, #{placedAt}, #{shipRecipientName}, #{shipPostalCode}, #{shipPrefecture}, #{shipCity}, #{shipAddressLine}, #{shipCountry}, #{billRecipientName}, #{billPostalCode}, #{billPrefecture}, #{billCity}, #{billAddressLine}, #{billCountry})

INSERT INTO order_lines (order_id, listing_id, release_title, artist_name, label_name, catalog_number, pressing_country, press_year, media_type, speed, disc_count, condition_type, vinyl_grade, sleeve_grade, unit_price_amount, unit_price_currency, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{listingId}, #{releaseTitle}, #{artistName}, #{labelName}, #{catalogNumber}, #{pressingCountry}, #{pressYear}, #{mediaType}, #{speed}, #{discCount}, #{conditionType}, #{vinylGrade}, #{sleeveGrade}, #{unitPriceAmount}, #{unitPriceCurrency}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, ship_recipient_name = #{shipRecipientName}, ship_postal_code = #{shipPostalCode}, ship_prefecture = #{shipPrefecture}, ship_city = #{shipCity}, ship_address_line = #{shipAddressLine}, ship_country = #{shipCountry}, bill_recipient_name = #{billRecipientName}, bill_postal_code = #{billPostalCode}, bill_prefecture = #{billPrefecture}, bill_city = #{billCity}, bill_address_line = #{billAddressLine}, bill_country = #{billCountry} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, status, placed_at, ship_recipient_name, ship_postal_code, ship_prefecture, ship_city, ship_address_line, ship_country, bill_recipient_name, bill_postal_code, bill_prefecture, bill_city, bill_address_line, bill_country FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT order_id, listing_id, release_title, artist_name, label_name, catalog_number, pressing_country, press_year, media_type, speed, disc_count, condition_type, vinyl_grade, sleeve_grade, unit_price_amount, unit_price_currency, quantity FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
